text: Adele Fiona Boone's (AFB3228) week from October 18 to 24, 2010, was flagged due to unusual volume of logons outside her working hours and browsing to job-search or leak-publication sites atypical for her role. The evidence suggests that she logged on 4 times outside her typical hours, which is the highest in the past 12 weeks. Additionally, she visited job-search sites 70 times, exceeding her usual range and even surpassing the average among peers in this role (8 visits).
